caption:
Two salons, from above.

Before any render, the layout: in the barbershop, five chairs along the mirror wall facing the shampoo and the waiting sofa, a washroom at the back; in the beauty salon, hair, nails and pedicure each in their own corner around a central waiting area.

Save it if you are planning a salon.
